{{Quote|In my time neither the Jedi nor we Renunciates used lightsabers. As part of their initiation, Padawans would forge their own steel blades and imbue them with the Force. And we would do the same.|[[Arden Lyn]]|<ref name="TEGW" />}}
A '''Force-imbued sword''', also known as a '''Jedi katana''', was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|bladed weapon]] used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] before the invention of the [[Protosaber]].

==History==
[[File:Arden_Lyn_and_Xendor.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Xendor]] wielding his Force-imbued blade during the [[First Great Schism]]]]
The Force-imbued blade was first conceived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] by the [[Je'daii Order]].<ref name="FaD" /> They saw widespread use throughout the [[Force Wars]] between the followers of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Ashla]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Bogan]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and the [[First Great Schism]]<ref name="TEGW" /> circa [[24,500 BBY]].<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> They were eventually replaced by the [[Protosaber]],<ref name="TEGW" /> which was based on the [[Forcesaber]]<ref name="DOTJ0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref> and would become the new standard weapon for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 1]]</ref>

Despite the common name, the blades were not exclusive to the Jedi, since they were also used extensively by followers of the Bogan during the Force Wars,<ref name="TEA" /> as well as by the [[Legions of Lettow]].<ref name="TEGW" />

==Description==
[[File:Force_Wars-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Followers of [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Ashla]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Bogan]], wielding Force-imbued blades of many different hues.]]

Force-imbued blades were solid metal blades that required no power source, and that glowed with the power of the Force coursing through them. This glow could manifest itself in multiple ways, ranging from lightning-like striations,<ref name="TEGW" /> a discoloration of the blade,<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> or a fire like manifestation.<ref name="TEA" />

==Creation==
Initially, the [[Je'daii]] used [[Vur Tepe]]<ref name="NoP" /> to imbue swords with the Force.<ref name="FaD" /> The practices and techniques that the Jedi used to create Force-imbued blades were also practiced by the Legions of Lettow at the [[Legionnaire Academy]].<ref name="TEGW" />

An initiate would select a bar of high-carbon metal and would hammer the bar into a blade; as it was forged, [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was channeled into the blade, altering the molecular structure of the metal into a reinforced lattice. This lattice both hardened the blade and sharpened the edge, as well as prepared the blade for the next step.<ref name="TEGW" />

Once the blade was forged, an initiate would place a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] into the hilt of the blade, and then would marry the lattices of the crystal and the blade together - this was accomplished by submerging oneself deep into the Force, and then [[Meditation/Legends|meditating]] on the blade and crystal until blade, crystal, and smith became as one. Once the lattices were married, the wielder would channel energy through the crystal and into the blade until it began to glow with a nimbus of energy, signifying that the blade had been permanently infused with the Force.<ref name="TEGW" />

The forging process was both physically and mentally taxing. Smiths ran the risk of shattering the blade, crystal, or both when channeling energy - whether due to imperfections in the lattices, or due to their inadequate skill.<ref name="TEGW" />
